tournaments_date_order.name: tournaments_date_order
tournaments_date_order.value: "tournaments"."ends_at" IS NULL OR "tournaments"."starts_at" IS NULL OR "tournaments"."ends_at" >= "tournaments"."starts_at"

cricket_innings_values.name: cricket_innings_values
cricket_innings_values.value: "cricket_innings"."number" > 0 AND "cricket_innings"."runs" >= 0 AND "cricket_innings"."wickets" BETWEEN 0 AND 10 AND "cricket_innings"."legal_balls" >= 0 AND "cricket_innings"."extras" BETWEEN 0 AND "cricket_innings"."runs" AND "cricket_innings"."batting_team_id" <> "cricket_innings"."bowling_team_id"

fantasy_rule_sets_bounds.name: fantasy_rule_sets_bounds
fantasy_rule_sets_bounds.value: "fantasy_rule_sets"."version" > 0 AND "fantasy_rule_sets"."squad_size" > 0 AND "fantasy_rule_sets"."starting_size" > 0 AND "fantasy_rule_sets"."starting_size" <= "fantasy_rule_sets"."squad_size" AND "fantasy_rule_sets"."budget" >= 0 AND "fantasy_rule_sets"."max_per_team" > 0 AND "fantasy_rule_sets"."max_per_team" <= "fantasy_rule_sets"."squad_size" AND "fantasy_rule_sets"."transfer_limit" >= 0 AND "fantasy_rule_sets"."captain_multiplier" >= 1

fantasy_scoring_rules_range.name: fantasy_scoring_rules_range
fantasy_scoring_rules_range.value: "fantasy_scoring_rules"."minimum" IS NULL OR "fantasy_scoring_rules"."maximum" IS NULL OR "fantasy_scoring_rules"."maximum" >= "fantasy_scoring_rules"."minimum"

fantasy_squad_picks_valid.name: fantasy_squad_picks_valid
fantasy_squad_picks_valid.value: "fantasy_squad_picks"."slot" > 0 AND "fantasy_squad_picks"."purchase_price" >= 0 AND NOT ("fantasy_squad_picks"."is_captain" AND "fantasy_squad_picks"."is_vice_captain") AND (NOT ("fantasy_squad_picks"."is_captain" OR "fantasy_squad_picks"."is_vice_captain") OR "fantasy_squad_picks"."is_starting")

matches_round_scope.name: matches_round_scope
matches_round_scope.value: "matches"."round_id" IS NULL OR "matches"."tournament_id" IS NOT NULL
